paragraphs: Today Lily is in the park. Her cousin Anna is with her. Anna is eight years old. She is a happy girl with long hair. Her classmate Leo comes to the park. "Who is she?" asks Leo. "She is my cousin," says Lily. "Hello, Anna!" says Leo. Anna smiles at him.

"Is Tom here?" asks Anna. "Yes, he is," says Lily. "He plays tennis with Dad." Tom and Dad hit a yellow ball. Dad likes tennis a lot. "Anna can swim," says Lily. "I can swim too!" says Leo. He puts his arms out on the grass. He is very funny! Anna and Lily laugh.

Pip comes with a red ball. "Throw it, Anna!" says Lily. Anna throws the ball. Pip runs fast. Leo tries to catch the ball, but Pip gets it. "Good dog!" says Anna. Now Tom and Dad come. The family and the friends play with Pip. The children are happy.
text.summary: Lily's cousin Anna comes to the park. Lily tells her classmate Leo one fact about each person in the family, and the children play a ball game.
